integrity: Analytic proof uses Barahona–Mahjoub complete facet description; exact-rational finite verification is corroborative, not a proof for unbounded graph sizes; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Proof and quantitative formula apply only to finite simple graphs with at least one edge and no K5 minor; the listed center is optimal but other minimizing centers are not classified; published-priority equivalence remains possible.
title: Odd girth determines the Minkowski asymmetry of \(K_5\)-minor-free cut polytopes
